summary: Delivery-probe alerts ask recipients to report existing delivery evidence without waiting for Doctor or treating a Doctor timeout as daemon stoppage.

replay.detail: Previously saved alert bodies retain their original replay behavior; sends and idempotency keys are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Newly constructed alerts use different advice text only; sends, IDs, recipients and saved-body replay are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The alert-text change requires no service interruption.

manual.detail: No manual upgrade steps are required.

recovery.detail: No migration is involved; reverting restores the prior advice for newly constructed alerts, while already saved alert bodies retain their text.
